decisions.statement: An initiative sits under another initiative or under no initiative.
An initiative takes each intent off the domain that had the intent and has the intent as its own.
An intent an initiative meets returns to the domain the intent came from or is deleted.
An intent returning to its domain is a design or condition decision.
An initiative is not limited to one domain.
An initiative's purpose is done once every intent that initiative has is met.
A state the migration passes through is an initiative.
An initiative dies when the initiative is reached rather than remaining as a domain that is done.
No initiative has an intent that is met.
An initiative is read from this definition rather than from the old system's.

definition: work that closes gaps between how a domain is and how it should be
